meta.title: 15 Vietnamese Street Food in Hoi An and Da Nang, Vietnam | What to Eat in Hoi An and Da Nang in 5D4N
meta.description:
Hoi An and Da Nang are two popular travel destinations located in Central Vietnam. One of the highlights of our trip was immersing ourselves in the local cuisines and trying out some of the best eats these cities had to offer. Here's everything we ate in Hoi And and Da Nang in 5D4N

➡️SUBSCRIBE for more videos:- https://www.youtube.com/puriandsue
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Itinerary: 

00:00 What to Eat in Hoi An and Da Nang, Vietnam - Introduction
➡️Hoi An Day 1​
00:33 1. Cao Lau
02:15 2. Banh Mi (Banh Mi Phuong)
03:28 3. Local Beer (Larue Beer)

➡️Hoi An Day 2
03:59 4. Vietnamese Coffee
04:53 Coconut Forest Basket Boat Ride & An Bang Beach
05:00 5. White Rose Dumpling
06:47 6. Banh Mi (Madam Khanh)
08:53 7. Visiting a Rooftop Cafe
09:43 8. Mot Herbal Tea
10:31 9. Com Ga

➡️Ba Na Hills & Da Nang Day 3
11:22 Ba Na Hills - Buffet Lunch at Arapang Restaurant
11:57 10. Mi Quang
13:43 11. Banh Trang Thit Heo

➡️Da Nang Day 4
15:23 Sala Danang Beach Hotel & My Khe Beach
15:40 12. Banh Xeo
17:37 13. Nem Lui
18:58 Son Tra Night Market and Dragon Bridge
19:21 14. Fresh Local Seafood

➡️Da Nang Day 5
22:39 15. Bun Cha Ca
24:42 Closing

I just visited Hoi An over the past 3 days, here are my recommendations

Great

1. Morning glory signatures - nice restaurant with fancy fusion food at great prices, i like the duck confit crispy noodles

2. Madam Khan Banh mi queen
Very nice, nicer bread than what u get in europe with generous fillings

Bad

1. Cao lau noodles
Reminds me of lor mee or mee rebus, not a fan of the sweet starchy gravy

2. White rose restaurant
Nothing special, very disappointing
